definitions.opening: the first moves of the game

beginner.guidance: Prefer everyday words. Use at most one short term from allowed_terms if it truly helps. Explain ideas in plain language.

definitions.tempo: a turn of time / pace in the position
definitions.fork: one piece attacks two targets at once
definitions.pin: a piece cannot move freely without exposing a more valuable piece behind it
definitions.skewer: a more valuable piece is attacked and must move, exposing a piece behind it
definitions.hanging: a piece is unprotected and can be taken

intermediate.guidance: Use club-level chess vocabulary from allowed_terms when accurate. Brief definitions are optional if a term might confuse.

definitions.prophylaxis: preventing the opponent's plan before it happens
definitions.zwischenzug: an in-between move that changes the expected sequence
definitions.outpost: a strong square for a piece that pawns cannot easily chase away
definitions.conversion: turning an advantage into a concrete win

advanced.guidance: Technical terms from allowed_terms are welcome when precise. Do not dumb down; stay accurate and concise.
